neutralDecoration.color: explicit RGBA independent from glyph fill with current-foreground convenience
neutralDecoration.metrics: compact renderer-neutral font decoration metrics plus numeric override

store dotted or wavy patterns in the glyph atlas
duplicate SDF resources per paint color
